::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 8th 1879  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 84-85
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

I enclose the receipts and agreement with many thanks. I hope the [Primer](cmy_books/cmybook_353.qmd) is doing well. One Blunder ought to be set right. I can’t help thinking it must have been a misprint. I knew it so well - ie that the Karling line had not died out - but been set aside.

I have done a good many correction to the [Christians & Moors](cmy_books/cmybook_126.qmd) and will finish them up when wanted.

As a matter of curiosity, what has [Mr Freeman](people/person_523.qmd) done with [France](cmy_books/cmybook_99.qmd)? I have kept all my old proofs for comparison when the book comes out.

Yours very truly
C M Yonge
